notes: New in Storage (2.9): the architect's lens for Iceberg and open table formats. When to use one and when not, who owns and pays for it, how it fails, and five under-the-hood answers: the metadata tree, commits from two writers, hidden partitioning, copy-on-write or merge-on-read, and compaction with snapshot expiry.
Three new interview questions, three quiz questions and eight reels for the lens; module 8 links to it.
